6.231 rsWrongNumberOfTablixCornerRows
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsWrongNumberOfTablixCornerRows is a critical error that will occur when the number of
TablixCornerRow elements for a Tablix is different from the number of distinct header rows created by
the TablixMember.TablixHeader elements in the Tablix.TablixColumnHierarchy.
